en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, and Ibn Bukeyr and someone else who said,

‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> was in the circumambulation (of the Kaaba), so he<sup>asws</sup> looked at a group around the Masjid. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is this group?’ So they said, ‘This is Muhammad Bin Shihab Al-Zahry. His intellect is muddled up, so he does not speak. So his family have brought him out, perhaps when he sees the people he would speak’.

So when Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> fulfilled his<sup>asws</sup> circumambulation, he<sup>asws</sup> went out until he<sup>asws</sup> approached him. So when Muhammad Bin Shihab saw him<sup>asws</sup>, he recognised him<sup>asws</sup>.

So Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘What is the matter with you?’ So he said, ‘I was given the governorship, so I shed blood. I killed a man, so there entered into me what you<sup>asws</sup> see’.
So Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> have more intense fear of your despair from the Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from what you have come to’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Give them the wergild’. He said, ‘I have done it, but they refused (to accept it)’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Make it as small packages, then wait for the timings of the Prayers, so throw these in their houses’.
